component.name: Face Unlock
component.summary: Unlock your screen with your face

description.p: Face Unlock enrolls your face and lets you unlock the lock screen, sudo and polkit prompts with it, showing a scan indicator while it looks.

This is a convenience feature, not Face ID. On an ordinary RGB webcam it can be defeated by a good video replay; an infrared camera is substantially stronger. Close look-alikes and siblings raise the chance of a false accept. Your password always continues to work, and face unlock stays disabled until you turn it on here.

ul.li: Guided enrollment across nine head poses, with a live preview
Several identities per account, for glasses on and off, or a dim room
Strictness settings, including a mode that requires evidence of a real 3D face
Diagnostics for the camera, models, services and PAM profile
One action that removes every enrolled template immediately

description.p: Photographs are never stored. Enrollment keeps only numeric templates, which are encrypted and readable by root alone.
Initial pre-alpha release. Not yet validated on real hardware.
